title: ArSciKids: Arabic Curriculum-Aligned Datasets for Scientific Experiment and Multiple-Choice Question Generation in Primary Education
abstract: arXiv:2611.01191v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Despite growing interest in Arabic natural language processing, curriculum-aligned educational resources remain scarce compared with English, and few public datasets for Arabic curriculum content with structured, generation-ready annotations are available, particularly for primary-school science. We introduce ArSciKids, a collection of two Arabic datasets designed for curriculum-aligned educational content generation: (1) a scientific-experiments dataset containing 999 manually curated records from official primary-school science textbooks in Saudi Arabia, Syria, and Jordan, and (2) an assessment-question dataset containing 2,167 multiple-choice questions collected from the Saudi Manhaji educational platform. The experiment records are structured with titles, objectives, tools, procedures, observations, conclusions, keywords, and grade levels, while the assessment records contain lesson references, questions, four answer options, correct

translated_title: ArSciKids：面向小学教育科学实验与选择题生成的阿拉伯语课程对齐数据集
translated_abstract: 尽管阿拉伯语自然语言处理的研究兴趣日益增长，但与英语相比，课程对齐的教育资源仍然稀缺，尤其是缺乏带有结构化、可直接用于生成任务标注的阿拉伯语课程内容公开数据集，小学科学领域更是如此。我们推出了ArSciKids，这是一个由两个阿拉伯语数据集组成的资源集合，专为课程对齐的教育内容生成而设计：（1）一个科学实验数据集，包含从沙特阿拉伯、叙利亚和约旦官方小学科学教材中人工整理的999条记录；（2）一个评估题目数据集，包含从沙特Manhaji教育平台收集的2,167道选择题。实验记录以标题、目标、工具、步骤、观察结果、结论、关键词和年级水平等字段进行结构化组织，而评估记录则包含课程引用、问题、四个答案选项、正确答案等信息。
tldr: 本文推出ArSciKids，这是首个面向小学科学教育的阿拉伯语课程对齐数据集，包含999条结构化科学实验记录和2,167道选择题，填补了阿拉伯语教育内容生成领域公开数据集的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ArSciKids, the first Arabic curriculum-aligned dataset collection for primary science education, comprising 999 structured scientific experiment records and 2,167 multiple-choice questions to fill the gap in publicly available Arabic educational content generation resources.
